attr.title: DaytonaArm
attr.desc: DaytonaArm runs Daytona USA (Sega Model 2, 1994 Revision A and Deluxe '93) on ARM64 handhelds through a static recompilation of the arcade code with an OpenGL ES 2.0 renderer, native audio and D-pad cab steering, tuned for the Anbernic RG34XX (Allwinner H700, Mali-G31).
attr.inst: Files are added manually to daytonaarm after install: 1) Copy your own legally dumped MAME ROM archive daytona.zip (Revision A 1994) and/or daytona93.zip (Deluxe '93) into daytonaarm/roms/. 2) On a PC, compile that ROM set into a native module with tools/build-arm64-cache.sh from github.com/DanimanX/DaytonaArm and copy the generated cache/daytona-aarch64.so and/or cache/daytona93-aarch64.so into daytonaarm/cache/. The game does not start until both are present.
